recipe.title: Aglio e Olio (Spaghetti with garlic olive oil)

ingredients.name: 500g/ 1 lb  spaghetti ((I use No 5 spaghetti but any long strand pasta will work))
2 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt (, for cooking pasta (halve for table salt, +50% for flakes))
1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil ((the better the oil, the tastier your pasta!))
1/2 tsp red chilli flakes ((red pepper flakes), optional - sub pinch of black pepper for not spicy)
1 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt ((halve for table salt, +50% for flakes))
1/2 cup reserved pasta cooking water (see Step 2)
Parmesan or parmigiano reggiano (, finely grated, for serving)

steps.text: Bring 4 litres / quarts of water to the boil. Add the 2 teaspoons of salt and the pasta. Cook for the packet direction time, MINUS 1 minute.
steps.label: Cook pasta
consumes_ingredients: 500g/ 1 lb  spaghetti ((I use No 5 spaghetti but any long strand pasta will work))
2 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt (, for cooking pasta (halve for table salt, +50% for flakes))

steps.text: Just before draining, scoop out 1 cup of the pasta cooking water. Then drain the pasta.
steps.label: Reserve pasta water
consumes_ingredients: 500g/ 1 lb  spaghetti ((I use No 5 spaghetti but any long strand pasta will work))
steps.doneness_cue: Just before draining, scoop out 1 cup of the pasta cooking water

steps.text: 4 minutes before the pasta is ready, heat the oil in a large ~30cm/12" deep pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and sauté gently for 2 - 3 minutes until it is a very light golden brown. Add the chilli flakes and stir for 20 - 30 seconds until the garlic is light golden; do not let the garlic become brown.
steps.label: Make garlic oil
consumes_ingredients: 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil ((the better the oil, the tastier your pasta!))
1/2 tsp red chilli flakes ((red pepper flakes), optional - sub pinch of black pepper for not spicy)
steps.doneness_cue: until it is a very light golden brown

steps.text: Add the drained pasta, 1/2 cup pasta cooking water (125 ml) and the 1 teaspoon salt. Toss over medium high heat until you no longer see water and oil pooled on the base of the pan, it has combined to form a sauce clinging to the pasta (~1 - 1 1/2 minutes). Add parsley, quickly toss through. If at any point the pasta gets sticky or gluggy, add another slosh of pasta water and toss to loosen.
steps.label: Toss pasta
consumes_ingredients: 1/2 cup reserved pasta cooking water (see Step 2)
1 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt ((halve for table salt, +50% for flakes))
steps.doneness_cue: until you no longer see water and oil pooled on the base of the pan

steps.text: Serve immediately with a shower of parmesan.
steps.label: Serve
consumes_ingredients: Parmesan or parmigiano reggiano (, finely grated, for serving)
steps.freshness_cue: Serve immediately with a shower of parmesan.
